title: yummy dense canadian peanut wrap
description: Jammy, dense, crowd-pleaser Canadian dish featuring roasted peanut, nigiri-shaping, Mediterranean-friendly, vessel=lotus-leaf-wrap
instructions: Combine honey, rye flour, and water in a small bowl to form a sticky dough.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Place a tablespoon of chopped peanuts in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape, pressing edges to seal.
Brush the tops with sesame oil and sprinkle with salt, red pepper, and cilantro.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and cook wraps for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Let wraps cool slightly before serving to prevent breakage.
For an added crunch, sprinkle with additional peanuts before serving.
Serve with your favorite dipping sauce, such as chili oil or sriracha.
Experiment with different fillings, such as hummus or avocado, for a unique twist.
